correctness.rationale: For smooth genus-three even-octic model in characteristic 3 reconstructed Cartier/Hasse–Witt coefficient matrix [[c,0,1],[0,b,0],[1,0,a]]. Its 2x2 block is invertible for ac!=1, rank-one when ac=1, and TT^(3) vanishes precisely when a+c³=0, equivalent a⁴=-1. Middle b block contributes stable rank one when b!=0. Squarefreeness shows b=0,ac=1 is excluded; on ac=1 smooth iff b is not 0 or a²+a^(-2). Thus no smooth rank0; rank1 locus four punctured lines, nonordinary divisors disjoint in U. Count squarefree monic quartics with constant 1 gives q³-q²+q-2; strata follow by counting divisor points, r_q=4 for even extension degree and 0 otherwise. Independent GF9 polynomial gcd and rank calculation reproduced N1=32,N2=101,N3=522. An all-extension theorem follows from the displayed algebraic reasoning, not finite enumeration.

The new full family has b!=0 strata of ranks1,2,3, so prior restricted slice is not a dominating theorem.

Prior quotient/extra-involution normal forms do not imply the particular 3-rank stratification and polynomial counts.

The explicit all-extension stratum cardinalities are new useful exact invariants of this natural coefficient family, distinct from a moduli isomorphism census.
